## MetricService

The metrics the platform collects for a project's compute instances, volumes and network interfaces: CPU time, network traffic, and volume reads and writes.

| Language | Client |
|---|---|
| Rust | `MetricClient::new(&client)` |
| Go | `observabilityv1beta1.NewMetricClient(client)` |
| TypeScript | `new MetricClient(client)` |

| RPC | Rust | Go | TypeScript | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `QueryTimeSeries` (`QueryTimeSeriesRequest`) | `query_time_series` | `QueryTimeSeries` | `queryTimeSeries` | Returns a resource's time series for the metrics asked, one per metric, in the order asked. requires `parent`, `resource`, `metrics`, `start_time`, `end_time`, `period`, `statistic` |

Field names: Rust uses the proto names (`size_gib`), Go protoc-gen-go's (`SizeGib`), TypeScript the JSON names (`sizeGib`).
